originalTitle: The Analogue Pocket gets a Supreme makeover in red or gold

content: Analogue and Supreme are teaming up to release metallic versions of the Analogue Pocket handheld in red and gold as part of Supreme’s fall / winter 2026 collection. Here’s how they’re described on Supreme’s website: > Metallic portable handheld multi-video-game-system. Unibody aluminum with 24K Gold-plated and custom red glossy finishes. They also have a Supreme logo on the front and the back. I dig the colors, but not the logos. (But I’m not really a Supreme guy.) No price is currently listed on the website for the handhelds. We’ve asked Analogue and Supreme how much they’ll cost. A standard Pocket costs $239.99. Supreme’s fall / winter 2026 collection features a few other gadgety things, too, including a Kodak Super 8 camera, a Dyson V12 Detect vacuum, a Jamo Capsule light, a JBL Go 5 speaker, and a set of wireless microphones and a receiver. The collection will be available on August 20th, Supreme says. chineseContent: Analogue 和 Supreme 联手推出红色和金色的 Analogue Pocket 手持式金属版本，作为 Supreme 2026 年秋冬系列的一部分。 Supreme 网站上对它们的描述如下： > 金属便携式手持式多视频游戏系统。一体式铝制机身，采用 24K 镀金和定制红色光泽饰面。它们的正面和背面都有 Supreme 标志。我喜欢颜色，但不喜欢徽标。 （但我并不是真正的 Supreme 人。）目前网站上没有列出手持设备的价格。我们询问了 Analogue 和 Supreme 的售价。标准 Pocket 的售价为 239.99 美元。 Supreme 的 2026 年秋冬系列还包括其他一些小玩意，包括柯达 Super 8 相机、戴森 V12 Detect 真空吸尘器、Jamo Capsule 灯、JBL Go 5 扬声器以及一组无线麦克风和接收器。 Supreme 表示，该系列将于 8 月 20 日上市。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/c5cc257d26bf6d71d7d981de0f95c36fb028a151-2450x2226.jpg.avif?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/9192f704c4a8d2f441ea34a6f7f3937b1b28115e-2450x2226.jpg.avif?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/9c1bbc2f85be555880e2a50b01adce31d1d1b639-1541x1800.jpg.avif?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/526478cff7c0f671a5b011c295366870144c4562-1685x1800.jpg.avif?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/b174db431e3190577076595ed38fcd1c892180a1-1381x1800.jpg.avif?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/b1d899c5903f6538e1f57c29f5d2e6a0
